text:
alex_marketing: Hey runtime — marketing needs a concise rerun for launch assets. Request: compare int8 vs q4f16 on long-context prompts to validate cold-starts and tail percentiles. Deliverables: run.csv (schema below), traces.tar.gz, README.yml, 50 QA samples, worst-100 slice, and a one-line exec summary.

Key parameters: model=redwood-open-70b, hardware=p4d, seed=20240714, total ~25k requests per variant (~1M tokens), concurrency cap=32, streaming=true, warmup=120s. Tag: marketing-launch-v1. Include billing_tokens_est column and decoding_retry_reason when present.

Sample payload to mirror: ```{"model":"redwood-open-70b","prompt_set":"long_tail_seeded_20240714","max_tokens":512,"temperature":0.0}```

jamie_runtime: Ack. Quick Qs: 1) Run both variants on same p4d cluster? 2) Do you want a separate cold-only run? Streaming traces add ~5% overhead.

alex_marketing: Same p4d cluster for both, no separate cold-only run — just mark cold_start_bool per request. Streaming traces = yes.

riley_eng: Submitting jobs now. CLI (audit): ```redwood-cli jobs submit --model redwood-open-70b --variant int8 --hardware p4d --concurrency 32 --seed 20240714 --warmup 120 --requests 25000 --streaming true --tag marketing-launch-v1:int8 --output s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-v1/int8/```

deploy-bot: Job queued — job_id=job-2026-06-01-7001-int8 ETA ~3h

riley_eng: Live samples during int8 run: 500-> p50 85ms p95 220ms p99 410ms cold_starts 3; 2000-> p50 88ms p95 228ms p99 430ms cold_starts 9.

alex_marketing: Please ensure run.csv columns: request_id, model, variant, hardware, start_ts, end_ts, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, cold_start_bool, decoding_retry_reason, billing_tokens_est, run_tag.

jamie_runtime: Will include README.yml with binary/commit and exact invocation. We'll post a single-line exec summary when each variant completes and full artifacts when both finish.

riley_eng: int8 completed: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-v1/int8/ (run.csv, traces.tar.gz, README.yml). Exec summary: int8: p50 86ms, p95 225ms, p99 412ms, cold-starts 26. Kicking q4f16 now (job-2026-06-01-7001-q4f16).

deploy-bot: job job-2026-06-01-7001-int8 completed successfully.

riley_eng: q4f16 done: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-v1/q4f16/ (run.csv, traces.tar.gz, README.yml). Exec summary: q4f16: p50 120ms, p95 305ms, p99 610ms, cold-starts 41.

alex_marketing: Great. One last ask: upload worst_requests.csv (top 100 by latency) and confirm sample outputs have been scanned for PII. Then @channel when the final summary doc is ready for comms. Thanks!
